paragraphs: Milestone Systems makes video technology software, with a portfolio of XProtect video management software, the BriefCam analytics platform, and Arcules video surveillance as a service. The company puts its products in more than 500,000 customer sites worldwide, from corner stores to critical infrastructure. Milestone dates its work in video technology to 1998.

XProtect is an open-platform system that connects cameras and sensors on premises, in the cloud, or as a hybrid of the two. More than 1,000 third-party applications extend the platform. Integrations include access control for managing entry points and license plate recognition for vehicle identification and tracking. Evidence Lock blocks alteration or deletion of selected footage so it holds up as evidence.

XProtect comes in four variants covering installations from single sites to global operations. Milestone releases XProtect updates 2-3 times a year and updated device packs 5-6 times yearly. Licenses are bought through a Milestone Partner.

quote.text: Transform physical security into a competitive advantage with products that amplify what organizations can achieve with video technology.
